quotations.old_english: His gást sceolde gefleógan tó heofena heáhnysse
Se earn on ðám ófre gesæt, mid fisce geflogen, þone hé ðǽrrihte geféng

source_text: ge-fleógan. Add :-- His gást sceolde gefleógan tó heofena heáhnysse, Shrn. 112, ii. Se earn on ðám ófre gesæt, mid fisce geflogen, þone hé ðǽrrihte geféng, Hml. Th. ii. 140, 3.
